answers.q1: pnpm (monorepo; the root package.json pins packageManager pnpm@12.10.0, and the preinstall script runs `npx only-allow pnpm`, so npm and yarn are rejected). Needs Node ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0. Install dependencies with: pnpm i (equivalent: pnpm install). Run `pnpm build` afterwards, because the playground tests need built packages.
answers.q2: pnpm test. This runs `pnpm test:unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`. CI also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, which `pnpm test` does not include. Playwright's browser must be installed first with `pnpm playwright install chromium`. For unit tests only, run `pnpm run test:unit`.
answers.q3: pnpm test:unit packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts. To run one case, add `-t "<test name>"`. Note that AGENTS.md says `pnpm test-unit`, but package.json defines the script as `test:unit`, so `test-unit` does not exist. The equivalent direct form is: pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts
answers.q4: CI's lint job runs these in order, from the repo root: `pnpm run build`, then `pnpm run lint:js`, then `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`, then `pnpm run typecheck`, then `pnpm run test-docs`. The lint and format checks are `pnpm run lint:js` (eslint) and `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code` (oxfmt, which fails if formatting changed any file). Build first, since the typed eslint rules and the typecheck rely on built output. AGENTS.md lists `pnpm lint`, but no such script exists; the real script is `lint:js`.
answers.q5: None are checked in as hand-edit-excluded generated source, but the following are generated or vendored. Build output: any `dist/` directory (for example packages/vite/dist) and `dist-ssr`. Per-run copies: `playground-temp/` and `temp/`. Caches: `.eslintcache`, `docs/.vitepress/cache` and `docs/.vitepress/.temp`. Also `packages/vite/LICENSE` (gitignored, generated at build) and `node_modules/`. Lockfile: `pnpm-lock.yaml` (changed only via pnpm). Patches: `patches/*.patch` (chokidar, dotenv-expand and sirv) are vendored dependency patches, so regenerate them with pnpm's patch tooling instead of hand-editing. ESLint ignores `packages/create-vite/template-*`, `**/fixtures/**` and `**/*.snap`. Snapshots (`*.snap`) are regenerated by running the tests with `-u` (vitest's update-snapshot flag).
